name: Layer Palm
description: Strike with a palm backed by several layers of folded space so the blow lands in repeated waves.

name: Layer Step
description: Step down through one layer of space and out of the next a pace away.

name: Layer Guard
description: Stack three thin layers of folded space before the chest so a blow spends itself on each.

name: Layer Feel
description: Feel the stacked layers about a foe and learn where they have been folded.

name: Twin Layer
description: Lay two layers of space over a foe's legs so each step drags and sinks.

name: Layer Slice
description: Cut through the topmost layer of space round a foe and let the cut run through the body.

name: Deep Layer
description: Pile layer on layer of folded space before the user until a heavy strike cannot reach through.

name: Layer Collapse
description: Collapse a whole stack of folds onto the foes before the user so they are crushed together.

name: Frame Palm
description: Strike within a frame of qi that keeps the blow straight and its force from leaking.

name: Frame Step
description: Raise a small frame ahead and step through it to the far side.

name: Frame Guard
description: Raise a stiff frame of qi before the body to catch a blow on its bars.

name: Frame Measure
description: Lay a frame over the field and read every body that crosses its lines.

name: Frame Hold
description: Close a frame about a foe's torso so the arms cannot swing outside it.

name: Frame Cut
description: Cut along the edge of a frame so the line of the cut passes through whatever it touches.

name: Frame Poise
description: Hold a steady frame about the user so every technique cast inside it runs smooth and sure.

name: Frame Break
description: Break a wide frame of space outward so its shards of force strike every foe within it.

name: Frame Seal
description: Close a final frame over one foe so their qi cannot pass out through it.

name: Stowed Blade
description: Draw a blade from the fold at the hip and strike with its edge in the same motion.

name: Stowed Palm
description: Strike with a palm that comes out of a fold of space close to the foe's guard.

name: Stowed Guard
description: Draw a plate from stowed space into the path of a blow and turn it aside.

name: Stowed Step
description: Step out of the stowed fold beside a foe as though the body had been waiting there.

name: Stowed Volley
description: Draw a handful of stones from stowed space and hurl them in a tight volley at one target.

name: Stowed Net
description: Cast a net drawn from stowed space over a foe so its cords tighten on every pull.

name: Stowed Arsenal
description: Release a dozen blades from folds all about the foes so they strike from every side at once.

name: Stowed Return
description: Send each spent weapon back into the fold and draw a fresh one so no strike runs dry.

name: Orbit Step
description: Circle round a fixed point in space and come out on the far side of a foe.

name: Orbit Palm
description: Swing a palm on the rim of a small orbit so it gathers speed before it lands.

name: Orbit Ring
description: Spin a ring of qi about the body so strikes are thrown out along its curve.

name: Orbit Jab
description: Whip a jab round the rim of an orbit to land on the back of a foe's guard.

name: Orbit Track
description: Follow the circling path of a moving foe and know where it will pass next.

name: Orbit Bind
description: Set a foe turning on a ring of space so their limbs follow it and cannot break away.

name: Orbit Sweep
description: Swing the body round a pivot point and clear all foes within the reach of the arc.

name: Orbit Pivot
description: Swing round a fixed anchor of space to change direction at full speed.

name: Orbit Lock
description: Hold a foe on a closed ring of space from which no step leads outward.

name: Orbit Fall
description: Swing the whole body down an orbit and land a blow with all the speed it has gathered.

name: Far Palm
description: Push a palm across a distance of several paces and strike the foe as if it stood close.

name: Far Step
description: Stride across a long stretch of ground by pulling the far point toward the foot.

name: Far Guard
description: Raise a guard at a spot a pace in front of the body where the blow will arrive.

name: Far Sight
description: Fold space before the eyes to see a distant place as if it lay close.

name: Far Hand
description: Reach a hand across the gap and seize a foe by the wrist from many paces away.

name: Far Strike
description: Throw a full body blow through a stretch of folded space to land on a distant target.

name: Far Lance
description: Drive a narrow lance of qi through the folded gap to pierce a foe across the field.

name: Far Ward
description: Set a ward of folded space about a distant ally so blows meant for them cross extra distance.

name: Plane Palm
description: Strike with a palm held flat along a plane of space so the whole hand lands at once.

name: Plane Step
description: Slide along a cut plane to a point a few paces to the side.

name: Plane Guard
description: Tilt a flat plane across the blow so it slides along it and off the body.

name: Plane Read
description: Read the planes that cut the air about a foe and learn how they have moved their weight.

name: Plane Cut
description: Cut a plane of space through the foe and let the halves shift apart.

name: Plane Slide
description: Slide the body along a long cut plane to arrive at the foe's back.

name: Plane Press
description: Press two planes together about a foe so their movement slows to a crawl.

name: Plane Sever
description: Sever a plane of space through the foe's guard and break the flow of their technique.

name: Planar Shield
description: Hold a great flat plane of space upright before the user to stop most strikes.

name: Slip Palm
description: Slip the palm through the gap between two guarding arms and strike the chest.

name: Slip Step
description: Slip out of the space the foe's strike will fill and in again beside it.

name: Slip Guard
description: Slip the guarding arm sideways through space so a blow glances off the forearm.

name: Slip Scan
description: Scan the space a foe will step into next and know where they will be a breath hence.

name: Slip Behind
description: Slip out of sight and return into the space directly behind a foe.

name: Slip Strike
description: Slip the whole body forward through folded space and land a blow in the same instant.

name: Slip Chain
description: Slip and strike three times from three sides in one unbroken run.

name: Slip Veil
description: Slip the body out of the space of a blow so it falls through where the user had stood.

name: Rift Palm
description: Strike a palm into a small rift that opens in the air beside the foe's guard.

name: Rift Step
description: Open a narrow rift ahead and step into it to come out a few paces on.

name: Rift Screen
description: Open a rift before the body that swallows the first force that meets it.

name: Rift Notice
description: Notice where a rift has opened or is about to open and mark its edges.

name: Rift Lance
description: Drive a lance of force through a rift so it strikes the foe from outside their guard.

name: Rift Pull
description: Open a rift behind a foe and drag them half through it.

name: Rift Burst
description: Burst a line of rifts across the ground so every foe over them is thrown up and torn.

name: Rift Snare
description: Leave a hidden rift on the ground that opens beneath the first foe to cross it.

name: Cell Palm
description: Strike with a palm that closes a small cell of space about the point of impact.

name: Cell Step
description: Pass from one cell of space to the next with a quick hop between their walls.

name: Cell Guard
description: Close a cell of space about the forearm so a blow cannot get through its wall.

name: Cell Count
description: Count the cells of space about a group and learn who stands apart from the rest.

name: Cell Close
description: Close a snug cell about a foe's arms and legs so they cannot be raised.

name: Cell Squeeze
description: Tighten a cell about a foe a little with each breath until the ribs groan.

name: Cell Brace
description: Hold a quiet cell of space about the user so that every breath and step inside it is steadier.

name: Cell Lock
description: Lock a cell shut about one foe so their qi and body cannot pass its wall.

name: Cell Array
description: Lay a row of linked cells in the ground that close in turn about any foe who enters.
